title: The Hidden Layer of MicroRNA Regulation in Gynecologic Cancers: IsomiRs, Arm Switching, and RNA Epitranscriptomic Modifications.
snippet: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are key regulators of gene expression that act primarily by binding to target messenger RNAs (mRNAs). However, the biology of miRNAs is more complex than initially thought, with functional complexity extending beyond canonical sequences.
